title: Ironing out the wrinkles - Nature Energy
text:
Ultrawide-bandgap perovskites are essential for all-perovskite triple-junction solar cells, yet their high bromide content causes surface wrinkling and halide disorder, limiting the performance. A surface reconstruction and halide homogenization strategy now enables a certified efficiency of 29.3% in all-perovskite triple-junction devices.
